evidence.title: CLINT Announcement of Results for Financial Year Ended 31 December 2025
evidence.excerpt: CLINT's FY2025 filing says Navi Mumbai Tower 2 is under construction and Chennai core-and-shell works are in progress as of the year-end reporting period.

metadata.navi_mumbai_tower_2_status_as_reported: Tower 2 (Power Load: ~55 MW) is under construction
metadata.chennai_status_as_reported: A planned power load capacity of approximately 53 MW is under development. Core and shell works are in progress
metadata.physical_status_scope: The year-end project update supports project-level under_construction as of 2025-12-31 for Tower 2 and Chennai. It does not establish a finer Tower 2 stage, a completed Chennai shell, MEP completion, energization, commissioning, completion, or operation.
metadata.forecast_guardrail: Tower 2's expected 1H 2027 phase-wise handover and Chennai's targeted 3Q 2026 completion are forecasts only and do not create lifecycle transitions.
metadata.tower_identity_guardrail: Navi Mumbai Tower 2 is a distinct current build inside the same campus as Tower 1. Tower 1's 2025 partial operation and handover must not be transferred to Tower 2.
metadata.chennai_identity_guardrail: CapitaLand DC Chennai in Ambattur is not merged with CapitaLand DC ITPH, ITPB/Bangalore, or another Chennai-area data center.
